title: SNATCH – Forest Fruits
description:
Snatch Forest Fruits Strong offers a sweet taste of berries topped with a hint of menthol.

The sweet taste of forest berries combined with menthol is a truly perfect blend of flavors. The semi moist pouches with a slim fit gives out both a steady release of flavors and nicotine. Snatch Forest Fruits clocks in at 16mg/g and here at SnusMe we would classify this as a “Strong” portion.

CONTENT AND INFORMATION

- Nicotine mg/g: 16

- Nicotine mg/pouch: 11,2

- Content: 14g

- Format: Slim

- Manufacturer: Consumer Brands International
